label_rationale: FNFT supply is credited before the ERC1155 receiver hook and the entry points are nonReentrant
mechanism: Revest Finance (Mar 2022): ERC1155 onERC1155Received reentrancy during FNFT minting; supply credited after the receiver hook
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'lockedValue', 'supplyOf', 'totalSupply']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for RevestFNFTPatched
  target property phi : totalSupply <= lockedValue
  exposure site       : mintFNFT.onERC1155Received  (receiver hook)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During mintFNFT's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['mintUnbacked', 'mintFNFT']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {lockedValue == totalSupply && _status == 1} pre-phase {lockedValue == totalSupply && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = lockedValue == totalSupply && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_mintUnbacked', 'OBL_cb_mintFNFT']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {lockedValue == totalSupply && _status == 1 /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => totalSupply <= lockedValue
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['mintUnbacked', 'mintFNFT'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback mintUnbacked preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback mintFNFT preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
entry precondition unsatisfiable in this phase (function excluded here)
